name: Ecommerce operations support: orders, returns & product listings (category)
summary: Behind-the-scenes work for online stores: processing orders, handling returns and shipping claims, and creating or updating product listings and feeds on Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces.
what_you_do: You upload and edit product listings (titles, photos, descriptions, prices), keep catalogues and marketplace feeds in sync, process daily orders through shipping tools, and log returns and damaged-shipment claims. Some roles add customer emails; senior roles add marketplace reporting, SEO and ERP or CRM integration.
who_it_may_fit: You like tidy data, online shopping systems and steady behind-the-scenes computer work.
Mostly written, detail-focused computer work
Shopify and Amazon Seller Central skills are named as assets even in general admin postings
Clear progression: an experienced ecommerce operations role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr (2026)
Can also be done as a freelancer for small online shops
who_it_may_not_fit: You need a fully remote entry-level job right away or dislike repetitive detail work.
Fully remote entry-level roles in Canada were scarce in searches; many are hybrid or in person (e.g. a $25/hr Vancouver contract required in-person shoots)
Canadian sellers also hire offshore assistants: one Canadian ecommerce company advertised a full-time remote assistant at $400–$550 USD/month (May 2025), which pushes freelance rates down
Jobs where you receive and reship parcels ('package inspector', 'quality control') are scams that can involve you in crime
'Product boosting' or task jobs that show earnings and then ask for crypto deposits are scams (CAFC warning)
Job Bank's e-commerce coordinator wages (median about $35.58/hr) describe a professional marketing occupation, not entry-level order processing

conditions_notes: Employee roles are steady. Freelance listing and order work follows store seasons and client budgets.
Employers usually expect platform skills (Shopify admin, Amazon Seller Central, shipping software). No specific training route was checked.

advertised_rate.note: Employer-stated pay in two Indeed postings read 2026-10-13 that include ecommerce tasks: $19–$23/hr (remote part-time admin, Shopify or Amazon an asset) and $25/hr (hybrid Vancouver contract managing Shopify listings). An experienced in-person role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr. Job Bank's e-commerce sales coordinator national median is $35.58/hr (range $20.50–$57.44; search summary).

economics_notes: Employer-stated pay in two Indeed postings read 2026-10-13 that include ecommerce tasks: $19–$23/hr (remote part-time admin, Shopify or Amazon an asset) and $25/hr (hybrid Vancouver contract managing Shopify listings).
